description:
## Objective

Port the Flow rejection and source-diagnostic authoring scenarios.

## Context

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-04-1255-test-flow-authoring-suite-plan.md`
Unit: `U3`
Covers: `R7-R9`, `R11-R14`, `KTD1-KTD6`

This task restores compile-time, source-location, and hostile-authoring regression proof through the current compiler and error contracts.

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: `jido-nnq.1` for shared fixtures, Catalog data, and the source ledger.
- Unblocks: `jido-nnq.4` by supplying rejection and source-diagnostic evidence.

## Branch and integration rule

- Base: `main` after `jido-nnq.1` lands.
- Combine: Remain independent from U2. U4 combines the landed U2 and U3 outputs.

## Source inventory

- Four source tests: `extension_test.exs`, `inline_hostile_test.exs`, `rejections_test.exs`, and `source_boundary_test.exs` — ported and adapted.
- Three related U1 support assets: `extension.ex`, `hostile.ex`, and `missing_output.ex` — reused and changed only for current contracts.

## API and behavior map

- Old compiler fixtures -> `JidoTest.AuthoringCompiler` and unique generated namespaces. Evidence: `test/support/authoring_compiler.ex`.
- Old exception modules -> stable current diagnostic message, path, phase, node, and source location. Evidence: `test/jido/flow/dsl/**`.
- Old component target and continuation rules -> current executable-kind and Invoke contracts. Evidence: `test/jido/flow/executable_kind_test.exs` and `test/jido/exec/**`.

## Files

- Read: fixed source diagnostic tests, `test/support/authoring_compiler.ex`, `test/jido/flow/dsl/{extension,inline_step,source_map,output_source}_test.exs`
- Change: `test/authoring/support/flows/{extension,hostile,missing_output}.ex` only when required
- Add: `test/authoring/flows/extension_test.exs`, `test/authoring/flows/inline_hostile_test.exs`, `test/authoring/flows/rejections_test.exs`, `test/authoring/flows/source_boundary_test.exs`
- Do not change: `lib/**`, `refs/**`, U2 component-matrix files
- Expected shared changes: bounded U1 fixture updates only

## Instructions

1. Compile source scenarios through the isolated current authoring compiler.
2. Replace removed error-type assertions with stable current diagnostics.
3. Preserve target-kind, local-scope, condition, state, Handoff, continuation, cycle, and output-order rejections.
4. Purge every generated module and run compilation or module-replacement cases serially.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Extensions and inline Actions lower or fail at the expected source declaration.
- [ ] Invalid targets, references, conditions, states, sinks, continuations, cycles, and outputs fail before Action work.
- [ ] Recompiled inline code keeps stored Flow data stable and changes only executable behavior.
- [ ] Generated modules do not leak between cases.
- [ ] No file under `lib/**` or `refs/**` changes.

## Verification

- `mix test.authoring test/authoring/flows/extension_test.exs test/authoring/flows/inline_hostile_test.exs test/authoring/flows/rejections_test.exs test/authoring/flows/source_boundary_test.exs --warnings-as-errors` — exits with status 0.
- `mix format --check-formatted` and `git diff --check` — exit with status 0.

## Handoff

In the Beadwork completion comment, list changed files, source disposition records, verification results, deviations from the plan, deferred assets, linked follow-up tickets, and remaining blockers.
A product failure must include the exact command, expected result, actual result, and a separate follow-up ticket before this task can close.

comments.text: Completed on local main as ba24216. Added extension_test.exs, inline_hostile_test.exs, rejections_test.exs, and source_boundary_test.exs. Adapted source paths, Jido.Joi schemas, Jido.Expr.Operation, and current execution error phase fields. Extended JidoTest.AuthoringCompiler with an isolated diagnostic-return path; all dynamic source cases use unique reserved namespaces and verify module removal. Verification: focused mix test.authoring command passed 22 tests with seed 0 and warnings as errors; the Flow authoring directory passed 58 tests; the complete authoring lane passed 132 tests; the existing Agent evaluation contract passed 19 tests; format and diff checks passed. No lib or refs files changed. The test-helper extension is the only plan file-list deviation and preserves the required source diagnostic without adding another compiler helper. No deferred asset, follow-up ticket, or remaining blocker.

title: Port Flow authoring diagnostics
